changelog.message: op created for dynamic visualization client registration and parameter synchronization
changelog.author: Antigravity

summary: Registers visualization client manifests (client:register) and synchronizes editable parameters with the Tweakpane Settings Dashboard.

ports.name: Process Message
ports.text: Trigger to process incoming WS Message Data from HttpFileServer.

ports.name: Server Instance
ports.text: Optional Server Instance from HttpFileServer for automatic broadcastExcept and client discovery.

ports.name: Discover Clients
ports.text: Broadcasts a client:discover request so active visualization pages re-send their registration manifests.

ports.name: Clear Registry
ports.text: Clears all registered client manifests and notifies connected dashboards.

ports.name: On Client Registered
ports.text: Fires whenever a visualization client registers or updates its manifest.

ports.name: On Parameter Update
ports.text: Fires when a parameter value is modified by a dashboard controller.

ports.name: Send WS Trigger
ports.text: Fires when WS Out Data is ready to be broadcasted via HttpFileServer.

ports.name: WS Out Data
ports.text: Outbound WebSocket payload (registry:sync, client:update, or client:discover).

ports.name: Registered Clients
ports.text: Dictionary of all registered client manifests keyed by clientId.

ports.name: Client IDs
ports.text: Array of currently registered clientId strings.

ports.name: Client Count
ports.text: Total number of registered visualization clients.

ports.name: Last Client ID
ports.text: The clientId of the most recently registered or updated client.

ports.name: Last Parameter Update
ports.text: Details of the most recent parameter change ({ clientId, key, value, parameters, originId }).
